articles.title: Murder Investigation Launched After Death of 31-Year-Old Nathan Haigh in Rochdale
articles.excerpt: A murder investigation is underway following the death of Nathan Haigh, 31, who was found unresponsive at a flat on Great Howarth. A 37-year-old woman has been arrested on suspicion of murder.
articles.content_html:
BREAKING NEWS — LIVE

Live updates, newest first.

13:33, 13 August 2026

A murder investigation is underway following the death of Nathan Haigh, 31, who was found unresponsive at a flat on Great Howarth. A 37-year-old woman has been arrested on suspicion of murder.

A murder investigation has been launched following the death of a 31-year-old man in Rochdale. Nathan Haigh was found unresponsive at a flat on Great Howarth, near Wardle, shortly before 7.40pm on Tuesday, August 11. Despite the efforts of emergency services, he was pronounced dead at the scene shortly thereafter.

A 37-year-old woman has been arrested on suspicion of murder and remains in custody for questioning. Greater Manchester Police stated that detectives are exploring several lines of enquiry in what they describe as suspicious circumstances. They have reassured the public that there is no wider risk to the community.

Detective Inspector Georgina Fearn from Rochdale CID expressed condolences to Mr Haigh's family and confirmed that specialist officers are available to support them during this difficult time. A police presence remains at the scene, with officers guarding the entrance to the block of flats where the incident occurred. Forensic teams have also been seen examining the property as part of the investigation.

The man's next of kin has been informed, and an inquest is expected to open in due course. Anyone with information related to the investigation is encouraged to contact Greater Manchester Police, quoting log 3306 of August 11.
